![What's new in Hamstr 0.7.2](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mailo037/Hamstr/v0.7.2/docs/images/releases/v0.7.2.png)

Hamstr 0.7.2 is a bugfix release that makes the desktop app light again and picks locked songs better.

- **Lighter on the desktop.** Hamstr kept redrawing its whole window at the monitor's full refresh rate for small ambient effects, which could take more than a CPU core on a fast screen. Ambient motion (the raster, the hamster's breath and blinks, loading rain, pulses) now stands still while the window isn't in front, and runs at a few steps a second while it is. In the background Hamstr uses next to no CPU.
- **One Hamstr.** Starting the desktop app a second time brings the open window to the front instead of opening another Hamstr, which also showed up as a device of its own in *Send to a device*.
- **The window moves with a sheet open.** The title bar stays usable: drag, minimize or close the window and the sheet stays where it is.
- **Send to a device:** rows keep their place instead of reordering with every signal, so a tap lands where it was aimed. A device that leaves (switched off, out of range, Hamstr closed) stays in the list as *Not available anymore*; a Hamstr that quits tells the others right away.
- **Locked songs on YouTube Music.** Spotify, Apple Music and SoundCloud links now give the artist and the length too, and every match is weighed by length and title, with covers, remixes and live takes ranked down. The best fit is offered first; *Other matches* lists the rest, each with a button to listen in before stashing it.

Signed APKs are available for arm64-v8a, armeabi-v7a, x86_64 and all ABIs together. The desktop installers aren't signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper ask before the first start. Verify every file against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
